name: java
description: OpenJDK 21 LTS - Java Development Kit with compiler, runtime, and development tools

java.description: Java runtime environment for executing Java applications and JAR files

javac.description: Java compiler for compiling Java source files to bytecode
javac.usage: javac MyClass.java | javac -cp lib/*.jar src/*.java | javac -d build src/*.java

jar.description: Java archive tool for creating and managing JAR files
jar.usage: jar -cf app.jar *.class | jar -xf archive.jar | jar -tf library.jar

javadoc.description: Java documentation generator for creating API documentation from source code
javadoc.usage: javadoc *.java | javadoc -d docs -sourcepath src com.example | javadoc -classpath lib/*.jar *.java

jarsigner.description: Java JAR signing and verification tool for code signing and security
jarsigner.usage: jarsigner -keystore keystore.jks app.jar mykey | jarsigner -verify signed.jar

javap.description: Java class file disassembler for analyzing bytecode and class structure
javap.usage: javap MyClass | javap -c -verbose MyClass.class | javap -classpath lib MyClass
